title: Compras 4.0: o que são e como implementar na sua empresa?
summary: As compras 4.0 ajudam na conquista de processos de procurement mais precisos e otimizados. Confira vantagens e como adotar esse conceito
body_text: Compras 4.0 consiste no uso de tecnologias inovadoras no setor de procurement, com o objetivo de aprimorar, otimizar, desburocratizar e aumentar a segurança das atividades relacionadas a essa área . Para falarmos mais sobre esse conceito, vale voltarmos um pouco no tempo e relembrar todas as revoluções industriais pelas quais o mundo já passou. A Primeira Revolução Industrial, por exemplo, foi marcada pela máquina a vapor. A Segunda teve como principal conquista a energia elétrica e, a Terceira, a informática e a robótica. Todos esses fatos, que aconteceram entre os séculos XVIII e XX, estudamos nas escolas e aprendemos detalhes em variados livros que falam sobre o tema. Mas o que muitas pessoas ainda não sabem é que estamos vivendo a Quarta Revolução Industrial. Desde meados de 2010, é possível dizer que entramos na era da automação , a qual trouxe tecnologias como Cloud Computing e Internet das Coisas, que abriram espaço para novos conceitos, a exemplo das compras 4.0. Mas quanto esse cenário pode afetar o dia a dia da sua empresa, principalmente a área de compras e procurement? Siga a leitura deste artigo e descubra! O que são as compras 4.0? Compras 4.0 pode ser definida como a implementação de tecnologias no setor de procurement para garantir que transações comerciais sejam mais eficientes e seguras . Dentre as inovações usadas nas compras 4.0, estão: Big Data; cloud computing (computação em nuvem); Inteligência artificial; robótica; Internet das coisas; realidade aumentada; impressoras 3D; Machine Learning. Dica de leitura! Aproveite e confira este artigo: “ Conheça 4 vantagens do uso do big data em Compliance ” Como as compras 4.0 impactam o setor de procurement? Com a chegada de novas tecnologias na área de procurement , como as que acabamos de citar, é certo afirmar que esse setor passou por um importante processo de inovação. Ao trazer o conceito de compras 4.0 para uma empresa, é possível alcançar benefícios como: mais agilidade nas operações; aumento da produtividade da equipe; redução de erros operacionais; diminuição de gastos. Mais agilidade nas operações Imagine o tempo que você levaria para ler uma planilha de 500 linhas para encontrar um valor específico. Agora, suponha que consiga comandar o Excel a realizar a busca para você. Muito mais rápido, não é mesmo? Esse exemplo pode ser bastante simples, mas ele demonstra com eficiência a relevância que a inovação pode ter no dia a dia de trabalho de uma equipe. Com as compras 4.0, o setor de procurement ganha mais segurança e agilidade, já que processos como ordens de compras, homologação de fornecedores e recebimentos acontecem quase que automaticamente. Aumento da produtividade da equipe Você precisa lidar com alguma burocracia que consome parte do seu tempo? É bem provável que sim. Mas, se você pudesse automatizá-la, não seria muito melhor para sua rotina? Com a automatização que citamos, que levam mais agilidade à rotina de procurement, a equipe terá outro benefício como resultado: mais tempo. Com ele, é possível se dedicar a diversas atividades estratégicas que podem aprimorar a dinâmica do departamento e o alcance de resultados mais significativos para a empresa. Redução de erros operacionais “Errar é humano”, já dizia o ditado. Apesar de haver a probabilidade de máquinas quebrarem ou pararem de funcionar, é possível afirmar que as chances são baixas. O que estamos querendo dizer com isso é que, nas compras 4.0 os erros são reduzidos drasticamente, evitando retrabalho e diminuindo as chances de ocorrerem equívocos que podem prejudicar as parcerias com os fornecedores. Diminuição de gastos Quando o setor de procurement se torna mais ágil, eficaz e comete menos erros, o resultado tende a ser um só: impacto positivo na parte financeira da empresa. Isso acontece porque, com a implementação de tecnologias das compras 4.0, é possível atingir pontos, como: aquisições de matérias-primas feita com antecedência, com maior possibilidade de negociar descontos; melhor controle de estoque, reduzindo perdas, especialmente de produtos com uma baixa duração (validade); compras mais precisas, visto que é possível saber em tempo real a quantidade de insumos disponíveis para a cadeia de suprimentos ; possibilidade de renovar contratos com mais facilidade e antecedência. Como implementar as compras 4.0 no setor de procurement? Para implementar as compras 4.0 no setor de procurement, é importante: compreender os processos atualmente realizados na companhia; identificar gargalos e falhas nesses processos; capacitar adequadamente a equipe à nova realidade. Compreender os processos atualmente realizados na companhia O primeiro passo para a implementação de qualquer procedimento de inovação em uma empresa é ter uma compreensão macro e micro de todos os processos adotados no momento pelo setor em questão. Quando falamos de procurement, por exemplo, isso pode incluir: compras estratégicas; logística de pedidos ; gerenciamento de contratos; controle dos estoques ; homologação de novos fornecedores; avaliação de performance do fornecedor. É claro que as responsabilidades podem mudar de acordo com a companhia, mas esse é um panorama que faz parte de grande parte das corporações. Identificar gargalos e falhas nesses processos Com todos os processos listados, o passo seguinte consiste em conversar com gestores e equipes de cada departamento relacionado à procurement, a fim de identificar quais gargalos estão afetando a produtividade dos times e as dinâmicas desse setor. Essa etapa é necessária porque a implementação de novas tecnologias é um investimento considerável para a empresa. Por conta disso, é imprescindível entender quais das inovações possíveis de serem adotadas gerarão mais impacto para a corporação. Como identificar gargalos Uma ferramenta que pode ajudar nesse processo é a matriz de probabilidade e impacto . Como você pode imaginar, nela são analisadas a probabilidade de um risco de tornar realidade e o impacto que ele teria na empresa. Cada um desses parâmetros é disposto nos eixos x e y de um gráfico. Em um deles, é analisado o nível de criticidade para probabilidade, que pode ser: improvável; pouco provável; possível; muito possível. No outro eixo, será analisada a criticidade do impacto, que pode ser: impacto nulo ou inexistente; impacto baixo; impacto médio; impacto alto. Quanto mais baixos forem a probabilidade e o impacto, menor a atenção que deve ser dada ao risco em questão. Por outro lado, à medida que um risco é classificado em um nível acima em um ou ambos os eixos, maior sua necessidade de atenção e importância. Se for notado que grande parte dos problemas estão relacionados aos fornecedores, por exemplo, pode ser válido investir em uma solução que proporcione mais controle e segurança para essas relações. No caso, a Linkana é a ferramenta ideal para esse trabalho, já que é uma plataforma de e-procurement especializada na homologação de fornecedores. Para isso, a ferramenta utiliza tecnologias como o RPA e o Machine Learning para realizar consultas públicas e emissão de certidões corporativas, garantindo que eles não ofereçam ameaças à imagem e à operação da sua empresa. Capacitar adequadamente a equipe à nova realidade Além de convidar os colaboradores a participarem da escolha das novas tecnologias, também é importante oferecer a capacitação adequada a eles. Isso não só aumenta a percepção de importância dos colaboradores para o sucesso da empresa, como também os ajuda a deixar de lado processos e práticas antigas. Se a meta é deixar a equipe mais eficiente, ofereça todas as ferramentas que forem possíveis para ajudá-los a alcançar esse objetivo. Como melhorar a implementação do conceito de compras 4.0? Definitivamente, as compras 4.0 são o futuro. Se sua empresa quer fazer parte dele, este é o momento certo para investir em soluções inovadoras que impactarão positivamente todos os departamentos e trarão benefícios significativos para a rotina de trabalho dos profissionais de procurement. Para isso, a gestão estratégica de fornecedores e a digitalização dos processos para identificar os mais adequados para compor a rede de abastecimento do seu negócio são primordiais. A pergunta que fica quanto a isso é: como realizar esses processos de uma maneira dinâmica, otimizada, segura e precisa? Um dos segredos é contar com uma base de dados de fornecedores compartilhada . Porém, essa é uma das principais lacunas deixadas pelos sistemas de compras e procurement disponíveis no mercado. O que é uma base de dados de fornecedores compartilhados? Uma fundação de dados compartilhados de fornecedores, como também pode ser chamada essa base, consiste em um sistema que permite o compartilhamento de informações validadas de fornecedores . Na prática, isso quer dizer que, a partir do momento que uma empresa tem o cadastro e os dados de um fornecedor verificados e aprovados, os demais usuários do mesmo software têm acesso a essas informações, diminuindo muito o tempo necessário nesse processo. Para quem fornece matéria-prima e serviços, uma das principais vantagens está em não precisar preencher diversos formulários, com solicitações de informações distintas que tornam essa etapa extremamente trabalhosa e burocrática. Já para os profissionais de compras e procurement, entre os benefícios de contar com uma base de dados de fornecedores compartilhados estão: redução do tempo necessário para encontrar empresas aptas a compor a cadeia de abastecimento da empresa; aumento da produtividade dos times de compras e procurement, já que grande parte do processo de análise de fornecedores já estará realizado; possibilidade de dedicar atenção a abordagens estratégicas que ajudam a alcançar mais e melhores resultados; redução dos riscos de contratar fornecedores com documentações vencidas, problemas cadastrais ou que não estão em compliance empresarial . Como a Linkana pode ajudar sua empresa com todos esses pontos? title: Prompt, Generate, then Cache: Cascade of Foundation Models makes Strong Few-shot Learners
summary: Tutorials, guides and deep dives into the best techniques and research for building reliable AI.
body_text: Do not index Original Paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.02151 Blog URL blog.athina.ai /prompt-...learners Original Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.02151 By: Renrui Zhang , Xiangfei Hu , Bohao Li , Siyuan Huang , Hanqiu Deng , Hongsheng Li , Yu Qiao , Peng Gao Abstract: Visual recognition in low-data regimes requires deep neural networks to learn generalized representations from limited training samples. Recently, CLIP-based methods have shown promising few-shot performance benefited from the contrastive language-image pre-training. We then question, if the more diverse pre-training knowledge can be cascaded to further assist few-shot representation learning. In this paper, we propose CaFo, a Cascade of Foundation models that incorporates diverse prior knowledge of various pre-training paradigms for better few-shot learning. Our CaFo incorporates CLIP's language-contrastive knowledge, DINO's vision-contrastive knowledge, DALL-E's vision-generative knowledge, and GPT-3's language-generative knowledge. Specifically, CaFo works by 'Prompt, Generate, then Cache'. Firstly, we leverage GPT-3 to produce textual inputs for prompting CLIP with rich downstream linguistic semantics. Then, we generate synthetic images via DALL-E to expand the few-shot training data without any manpower. At last, we introduce a learnable cache model to adaptively blend the predictions from CLIP and DINO. By such collaboration, CaFo can fully unleash the potential of different pre-training methods and unify them to perform state-of-the-art for few-shot classification. Code is available at this https URL Summary Notes Enhancing Few-shot Learning with Cascades of Foundation Models (CaFo) Introduction Few-shot learning is a crucial challenge in AI, where the goal is to develop models that can accurately learn from limited data. Traditional methods have made progress, but often struggle with complex real-world scenarios. Enter the "CaFo" framework, a groundbreaking approach that uses a series of pre-trained models to dramatically improve few-shot learning. The Challenges of Few-shot Learning The essence of few-shot learning is to teach models to accurately classify or understand data with only a few examples. Although techniques like meta-learning and metric learning have been developed to tackle this, they frequently require elaborate setup and may not work well across different tasks. Background Work Lately, the focus has shifted towards using large pre-trained models, which are trained on vast datasets and can offer a rich understanding for few-shot learning. Specifically, combining language and visual models has shown great promise in enhancing the models' understanding of both text and images in few-shot tasks. Introducing the CaFo Framework The CaFo framework is a breakthrough in few-shot learning, uniquely combining four types of pre-trained models to support the learning process: CLIP : Provides understanding of textual and visual data relationships. DINO : Enhances visual recognition. DALL-E : Creates synthetic images to expand training data. GPT-3 : Generates linguistic prompts to guide the learning focus. These models are integrated through a three-step process called Prompt, Generate, then Cache. GPT-3 starts by creating prompts that help CLIP understand the task. DALL-E follows by generating synthetic images for more diverse examples. Lastly, a learnable cache model uses predictions from CLIP and DINO, refining the output with the few-shot examples. Performance and Results Testing CaFo across 11 datasets proved its outstanding performance in few-shot learning, especially in settings with very limited data. It consistently surpassed existing methods, showcasing its adaptability and learning capabilities from minimal examples. Conclusion and Key Takeaways CaFo stands out by cleverly using diverse pre-trained models to address few-shot learning's challenges. Its unique cache model efficiently combines predictions for better accuracy. The framework is highly adaptable, promising for applications facing data scarcity. Key Contributions Pre-training Knowledge Integration : Combining CLIP, DINO, DALL-E, and GPT-3 into a unified learning approach. Innovative Cache Model : An adaptive method to enhance prediction accuracy in few-shot scenarios. Thorough Validation : Proven effectiveness of CaFo across multiple datasets. Looking Forward Future enhancements could include integrating additional pre-trained models and expanding to more domains, potentially making CaFo even more versatile and powerful for few-shot learning. The CaFo framework offers AI Engineers in enterprises a new strategy for overcoming few-shot learning challenges, leveraging the power of foundation models to develop more versatile, efficient, and adaptable AI systems. title: Top 4 Medical Industry Trends From MD&M West 2023
summary: The medical industry is experiencing an exciting transformation, driven by recent breakthroughs in Artificial Intelligence (AI), increased decentralization of care, as well as the miniaturization of technologies that power medical devices.
body_text: Advanced Energy recently attended the Medical Device & Manufacturing West (MD&M West) trade show on February 6-9 in Anaheim, CA. This year, MD&M West gathered over 1,500 exhibitors and 15,000+ attendees from the medical industry – from top medical devices and equipment makers, power supply providers, thought leaders and engineers. Over the span of four days, Advanced Energy’s team exhibited on the show floor, engaged with industry leaders and observed the latest trends driving the medical industry. The medical industry is experiencing an exciting transformation, driven by recent breakthroughs in Artificial Intelligence (AI), increased decentralization of care, as well as the miniaturization of technologies that power medical devices. The COVID-19 pandemic stressed the need to establish a method of delivering acute and scheduled care outside the traditional hospital environment. This will drive increased deployment of home healthcare equipment, improved data acquisition, as well as further advances on communications technology in medical equipment. Here are some key trends we observed at MD&M West 2023: 1. Increased Adoption of Batteries in Medical Equipment According to a 2023 report by Future Market Insights , the global portable medical devices market is projected to grow from $59.3 billion in 2023 to $163.8 billion by 2033 – a CAGR of 10.7%. There is an increasing need for batteries as patient care becomes more decentralized. Medical devices, ranging from health wearables and in vivo parts such as pacemakers to patient monitoring and diagnostics equipment, are increasingly being used on the go. This shift presents a unique set of challenges. Battery safety, lifetime, charging capacity and size are increasingly critical for medical device system performance. Medical device and equipment makers are demanding ever smaller, more powerful and reliable power solutions. In addition, increasing demand for electric vehicles (EVs) results in limited battery cells for medical equipment. 2. Point-of-Care Treatment Impacts Equipment Design The decentralization of care also means that point-of-care and at-home devices are in increasing demand. The medical equipment industry is focusing on smaller, more portable devices that can be used either at home, or in smaller clinics and ambulatory environments. Equipment use in these “less controlled” environments will have a significant impact on equipment design from a safety and Electro-Magnetic (EMI) perspective. In this dynamic environment, it’s more important than ever to engage with strategic partners and collaborate early in the design and development process to identify each application’s differentiated needs. Advanced Energy’s Customer Experience Centers (CEC) work with customers around the world to solve design challenges throughout their product lifecycle. Our Sharon, MA center services our medical customers with an experienced engineering team as well as sophisticated EMI, thermal and electronic test equipment. Read more about Advanced Energy’s network of CECs here . 3. AI Expands Into Diagnostics, Prevention and Therapy Recent breakthroughs in Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies have occupied headlines for the past weeks. Beyond the chatbots and the “smart search” capabilities widely covered in the media, AI enabled Machine Learning (ML) offers potential upsides in the medical industry. Several AI and ML technologies already exist to assist with the medical diagnostics process. According to the U.S. Government Accountability Office , diagnostic errors affect more than 12 million people in the U.S. each year, costing $100 billion. Using AI and ML results in earlier detection of diseases, as well as more consistent and accurate data analysis. Because of their use in medical settings, these technologies require FDA reviews. In imaging applications, benefits of AI extend beyond reducing diagnosis time. Shorter scans mean lower patient exposure to radiation. Smart detection and classification of images help to accelerate time to treatment, which helps improve patient care and outcomes. 4. Big Data and Analytics Enter the Realm of Healthcare Big Data and analytics offer promising applications in the medical industry, enabling improved patient outcomes, personalized care and even reduced treatment costs. Big Data applied to a population can potentially help manage and prevent disease outbreaks, as demonstrated by Taiwan’s early COVID-19 pandemic response program . While some devices such as fitness trackers are already documenting our personal data, assembling health information on a large scale and integrating it within existing medical systems raise security and data privacy concerns. Securing patient information and the integrity of networks is a first step in implement Big Data and analytics in healthcare. These trends underline the need for the medical industry for continued innovation in technology – from AI, ML and big data to hardware improvements. Reliability continues to be a critical requirement in medical equipment design and development. With the rise of Big Data and analytics in healthcare, reliability now extends to system security as well. With over 40 years of leadership in power conversion, measurement and control solutions, Advanced Energy continues to enable our customers’ innovations with a broad portfolio of medical standard, custom and configurable products . Designed to meet current and future international safety certifications, our high-efficiency, high-performance power supplies feature unrivalled reliability for medical applications across the entire continuum of care.

title: MyMD Joins LOT Network in Effort to Protect Company and Shareholders from Patent Trolls

body_text: MyMD Joins LOT Network in Effort to Protect Company and Shareholders from Patent Trolls March 08, 2023 8:30am EST Download as PDF BALTIMORE--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- MyMD Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ® (Nasdaq: MYMD) (“MyMD” or “the Company”), a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company developing groundbreaking therapies for the treatment of serious and debilitating autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, today announced that it has joined LOT Network , the international, non-profit community of companies working together to protect themselves against litigation brought on by patent assertion entities (PAEs, also known as “patent trolls”). MyMD’s joining the LOT (License on Transfer) Network’s community of 2,800+ companies is intended to enable MyMD to protect the interests of the Company against patent assertion entities. The LOT Network community is committed to protecting members against frivolous PAE litigation. Members agree that if, and only if, a member’s patent asset falls into the hands of a PAE, other members are granted a license to that patent – rendering them immune to a PAE lawsuit using that patent. With a total of 2,289 patent troll cases in 2022 alone,1 the average lawsuit costing $4 million to defend,2 and 87% of patent assets used in PAE lawsuits originating from operating companies,3 LOT Network’s coverage of nearly 4 million patent assets globally provides broad protection and peace of mind to member companies. “Biotech companies are increasingly finding themselves defending costly patent-troll lawsuits,” said Christopher Chapman, MD, Director, and Chief Medical Officer at MyMD Pharmaceuticals. “MyMD joins a growing number of life science companies leveraging LOT Network as a layer of protection against troll litigation, so that we can continue to focus our resources on our clinical development programs and protect our expansive IP portfolio and the interests of our shareholders.” “We are pleased to welcome MyMD into LOT Network,” said Ken Seddon, CEO of LOT Network. “Joining the community demonstrates their commitment to preserving their resources for innovation and protecting their ecosystem against unwanted litigation.” About MyMD Pharmaceuticals MyMD Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: MYMD), is a clinical stage biopharma company developing groundbreaking therapies for the treatment of serious and debilitating autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. MyMD’s lead clinical candidate, MYMD-1®, is an orally available next-generation TNF-alpha inhibitor with the potential to transform the way that TNF-alpha based diseases are treated. MYMD-1®, with its small molecule design, improved safety profile and ability to cross the blood brain barrier, has the promise to provide meaningful therapeutic solutions to patients not served by current TNF-alpha inhibitors and as a potential therapy for CNS-based inflammatory and autoimmune diseases. MYMD-1 has demonstrated the potential to slow the aging process and extend healthy lifespan. The company is evaluating MYMD-1® in Phase 2 studies for sarcopenia/frailty, a result of the aging process, as well as early-stage trials for rheumatoid arthritis (RA), with the potential to expand into other applications. MyMD’s second therapeutic candidate is Supera-CBD™, a novel, synthetic, non-toxic cannabidiol (CBD) analog that is 8000 times more potent a CB2 agonist (activator) than plant-based CBD. In addition to its potential role in managing addiction, anxiety, chronic pain and seizures, Supera-CBD has also been shown to have anti-inflammatory effects. For more information, visit www.mymd.com . About LOT Network LOT Network is an international community of the world’s leading high-tech companies committed to protecting its members from costly litigation from patent assertion entities (PAEs). LOT Network currently protects more than 2,800 members in 56 countries from litigation from over 3.8 million worldwide patents and counting. Members include market leaders such as IBM, Toyota, JP Morgan Chase, Canon, Google, Tesla, Disney, Cisco, Amazon, Microsoft, BP, Alibaba, and Dow, as well as innovative companies across all high-tech industries. title: Why we have an engineering handbook?
summary: Whenever someone joins Rdash engineering department, he/she would be overwhelmed by the amount of information and context that they need to…
body_text: Press enter or click to view image in full size Photo by Sigmund on Unsplash Why we have an engineering handbook? Amit Kumar 3 min read · Mar 16, 2023 -- Whenever someone joins Rdash engineering department, he/she would be overwhelmed by the amount of information and context that they need to process. There are multiple teams, processes, tools, and guidelines that one has to get accustomed to. The engineering handbook serves as a comprehensive guide to streamline this onboarding process and provide a clear understanding of what is expected from them. It also acts as a reference guide for engineers to refer to whenever they need to clarify a guideline or process. The objective of this handbook is simple, it act as an operating system for engineering department. We have extensively written down everything from the values that we cultivate in employee to coding guidelines that we want to enforce. Our values section in the engineering handbook provides a clear understanding of the core principles and beliefs that guide our work. We believe in transparency, collaboration, and continuous improvement, and we strive to embody these values in everything we do. By aligning our actions with these values, we can better serve our customers, improve our products, and create a positive work environment for everyone on the team. Get Amit Kumar’s stories in your inbox Join Medium for free to get updates from this writer. Remember me for faster sign in Then we have a section dedicated to our working style. It has everything from building things efficiently to guidelines for work from home. As an organization, we value a lot the practice of writing things down whenever we discuss things. Then we have guidelines to conduct effective 1–1 meetings. We have also codified our rituals that we follow as part of our working, such as sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups. These rituals ensure that everyone on the team is aligned and working towards the same goals, and that we are continuously improving our processes and products. Press enter or click to view image in full size Photo by Razvan Chisu on Unsplash The engineering handbook also includes a section on career growth and development opportunities. This section outlines the different career paths available to engineers at Rdash and provides guidance on how to progress and grow within the organization. By providing a clear understanding of career growth opportunities, we can help our engineers to set goals and work towards achieving them. This not only benefits the individual engineer but also the organization as a whole, as we can ensure that we have a talented and motivated workforce that is equipped to tackle any challenge. Finally, the engineering handbook includes technical guidelines and best practices for coding, code reviews, testing, and deployment. These guidelines help to ensure that our code is maintainable, scalable, and secure, and that we are delivering high-quality products to our customers. By following these guidelines, we can minimize errors and bugs, reduce technical debt, and improve the overall performance of our products. In short, the engineering handbook serves as a comprehensive guide to help engineers at Rdash understand our values, working style, and technical guidelines, and to help them operate at the highest level of productivity and success. The engineering handbook is a living document that is constantly updated and improved based on feedback from engineers and changes in our organization. It is a reflection of our culture and values, and it helps to ensure that everyone on the team is working towards the same goals and delivering high-quality products to our customers.

title: Tips for Dining Out
body_text: By: Kendra Schapansky, RD, CNSC March 12, 2023 Dining out at restaurants is a nice treat but also challenging when trying to stick with your therapeutic diet, especially with gastrointestinal diseases. Most restaurants have menus and nutritional information available online. Restaurants are not required to have nutrition information available if they have less than 20 locations. Follow these tips to navigate eating out if you have specialized nutrition needs. GENERAL TIPS: Research the menu online Pick a cuisine you tolerate Ask server for nutritional information or ingredients if not listed on the menu Do NOT be afraid to ask to customize the meal or ask for specific changes Communicate with wait staff if you have a food allergy or intolerance HAVE A PLAN AND STICK WITH IT! title: Yasmeen Yehia: Defeating My Own Imposter
summary: My name is Yasmeen Yehia and I am an Egyptian Computer Science student. I am writing this from Glasgow, Scotland where I’ve been for the…
body_text: Yasmeen Yehia: Defeating My Own Imposter Manara 3 min read · Mar 13, 2023 -- My name is Yasmeen Yehia and I am an Egyptian Computer Science student. I am writing this from Glasgow, Scotland where I’ve been for the past 4 months as an exchange student. I’m not going to tell you about how I got here, but I want to let you know that in a few months I’m moving permanently to Germany to work for Freiheit in Hamburg. Exciting, right?! Press enter or click to view image in full size It started all the way back when I was in the 10th grade. That’s when my passion for coding started. It simply came natural to me, and my teachers immediately saw that. They signed me up to national competitions, and even encouraged me to register with the top STEM school in Egypt. However, I was living in a paradox: the more I learned about this world, the more I felt that I really knew nothing. For me, my dream was to work in Google, but that dream would come way later in my life and career. Where I was at that time, I wasn’t on route to Google. I wasn’t on route anywhere really! Press enter or click to view image in full size And this was when I came across the YouTuber Eman Sobhy’s series “What If?”, and her video about Manara. She (along with the several stories from Manara alumni on Medium) held my hand tight just when I was giving up hope on that dream and took me back to my intended path. Manara made me realize that my dream was attainable, so I applied. After getting accepted, I got to work! I drilled down on the coding tests and assignments, and the mock interview preparations. I discovered a whole new world of exceptional mentors and a supportive community who were always there for me. But there was always a doubt in me. Always that person in me kicking me down. But who picked me up? Iliana Montauk, Manara’s co-founder and CEO. She made me expand my dreams beyond the confines of my country. She, along with the entire community of staff, mentors, teachers, and peers, made me realize that there is a whole world out there within my reach. A world where someone like me can leave her country and work in any tech company she wanted! Press enter or click to view image in full size And it was around this time that Freiheit’s name came up through an online conference Manara organized with them for their students. I admit, I didn’t know much about them when I started interviewing, but I immediately fell in love with their office culture. How did I know? During my interviews I would sneak a peek behind the interviewer to look at their office and the people working there! Looked like a lot of fun! With Manara, I found the real Yasmeen. The one who was hiding behind this imposter kicking me down. And I love her!
